name: mcp-account-hiring-watch
description: MCP server for Account Hiring Watch. Watch company domains and get only what changed since the last run: new, closed, and reposted job postings read live from 17 job boards, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and Workday among them. Each row has the full job description, a stable posting key, and 30 day hiring velocity. Runs on Apify. Clay-ready output.
